findings.requirement: Preserve existing benign SQLite trigger behavior and allow valid public transfers.
findings.evidence: Initialize accounts ('one','a',100) and ('one','b',0), then execute the Python SQL string 'CREATE TRIGGER benign \x0b AFTER INSERT ON audit BEGIN SELECT 1; END'. Native SQLite and .pre-repair accept the transfer of 10 from a to b. Current vault.transfer raises sqlite3.DatabaseError('unsupported trigger definition'); CLI exits 2 with a generic error. Reproduced through both interfaces in DELETE and WAL modes. Rows and schema remain unchanged. The revised whitespace class omits SQLite's accepted vertical-tab separator. A token-boundary U+FEFF separator demonstrates the same tokenizer mismatch, although that example also fails before repair.
findings.suggested_fix: Match SQLite's whitespace tokenization, including vertical tab and token-boundary U+FEFF, while preserving non-ASCII identifier characters such as U+00A0. Add native-control regressions for these separators.

checks: Read lean-run, write-integrity guidance, AGENTS.md and CONTRACT.md; compared current source with .baseline and .pre-repair; inspected added tests.
python3 -B -m unittest discover -v: all 33 tests passed.
Independently reproduced COORD-TRIGGER-COUNTER against .pre-repair. Current API and CLI match native SQLite in DELETE/WAL, including replay and schema preservation.
Independently reproduced COORD-UNICODE-SPACE-TRIGGER against .pre-repair. Current unquoted and quoted U+00A0 controls succeed in API/CLI and DELETE/WAL; replay remains unchanged.
Independently verified the remaining separator finding against native SQLite and .pre-repair, with rollback and schema checks.

UTF-8, UTF-16le and UTF-16be probes preserved malformed foreign text and duplicate history, rejected INTEGER-to-REAL and TEXT-to-BLOB changes atomically, rejected hidden rowid deletion, and accepted ignored replacements.
Assessment made no application, test, instruction or baseline changes; temporary probe databases were cleaned up.
